and status = 7

'/purchase/rfqs', purchase_org_id, created_by, date(quote_deadline), 'purchase_rfq', cast(id as char), created_at, updated_at from purchase_rfq where deleted = 0 and status = 1 union all select concat('BID_TO_AWARD:', id), 'BID_TO_AWARD', compare_no, concat('定标比价结果 ', compare_no), '待定标', 'HIGH', 1, '/purchase/compare-results', purchase_org_id, created_by, null, 'purchase_bid_comparison', cast(id as char), created_at, updated_at from purchase_bid_comparison where deleted = 0 and status = 1 union all select concat('PO_APPROVAL:', id), 'PO_APPROVAL', order_no, concat('审批采购订单 ', order_no), '待审批', 'NORMAL', 2, '/purchase/orders', purchase_org_id, created_by, null, 'purchase_order', cast(id as char), created_at, updated_at from purchase_order where deleted = 0 and status = 2 union all select concat('PO_TO_RELEASE:', id), 'PO_TO_RELEASE', order_no, concat('发布采购订单 ', order_no), '已审批', 'NORMAL', 2, '/purchase/orders', purchase_org_id, created_by, null, 'purchase_order', purchase_order where deleted = 0 and status in (6, 12) union all select concat('DELIVERY_OVERDUE:', purchase_order_line.line_id), 'DELIVERY_OVERDUE', purchase_order.order_no, concat('处理逾期订单行 ', purchase_order_line.required_delivery_date, 'purchase_order_line', cast(purchase_order_line.line_id as char), purchase_order_line.created_at, purchase_order_line.updated_at from purchase_order_line join purchase_order on purchase_order.id = purchase_order_line.order_id where purchase_order_line.deleted = 0 and purchase_order.deleted = 0 and purchase_order.status not in (8, 9, 10) and from purchase_price where deleted = 0 and status = 1 and effective_to between #{criteria.businessDate} and date_add(#{criteria.businessDate}, interval 30 day) union all select concat('INBOUND_EXCEPTION:', id), 'INBOUND_EXCEPTION', inbound_no, concat('处理到货异常 ', inbound_no), '异常', 'URGENT', 0, '/purchase/inbound-tracks', purchase_org_id, created_by, null, 'purchase_inbound_tracking', cast(id as char), created_at, updated_at from purchase_inbound_tracking where deleted = 0 and status = 7 union all select concat('SUPPLIER_RETURN_APPROVAL:', id),
